comments.text:
Got it like 10 hours ago. It’s quite buggy.
It did however get the timing right, but I had to locate the chat to see the result. And, you can set up multiple independent tasks in one chat, which I think is not smart. Can’t schedule anything with Projects, but GPTs can be invoked by schedule. You need to change the prompt so the trigger message start some action. Tasks don’t allow file uploads but do support web browsing.
I think this is a step in the right direction, towards using ChatGPT for business process steps, and I hope they enhance Tasks with other triggers, like presence of a file or a ping from another task. Moving into agentic territory, then.
